convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for AFL_WinnerSign custom indicator, includes external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms, multi-timeframe logic with custom indicator

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade open timing

other_exits: Buy position closed when AFL_WinnerSign Buffer 0 (DnValue) is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan (signal reversal exit)
Sell position closed when AFL_WinnerSign Buffer 1 (UpValue) is non-zero and not EMPTY_VALUE on a historical bar scan (signal reversal exit)
Close signals are scanned forward from SignalBar+1 through all bars when both open and close flags are enabled for same side but no close signal found on SignalBar

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin, BALANCE=MM fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=MM fraction of balance minus losses

custom_logic_notes: The EA scans for close signals by iterating through historical bars from SignalBar+1 forward when both open and close are enabled for a side but no close signal was found on the SignalBar itself. This is a supplementary exit search. SignalBar=1 means signals are read from the previous completed bar (bar index 1). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entries, short entries, long exits, and short exits. The AFL_WinnerSign custom indicator must be available as a compiled .ex5 file for iCustom to work.
python_conversion_notes: The AFL_WinnerSign custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python since it is loaded via iCustom. The indicator uses the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing methods) which must also be ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, and CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode conditional position sizing logic (5 modes) must be faithfully reproduced. The historical bar scan for supplementary close signals (lines 173-199) must be carefully ported as it searches beyond SignalBar for exit conditions. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points may need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). SignalBar=1 means the strategy uses confirmed (previous bar) signals, not current bar.
